environment.description: ECS Fargate task running in a public subnet with an Internet Gateway route. Task role has s3:PutObject on the application bucket. Container runs as root with read-write root filesystem. ALB forwards /upload directly to the container on port 8080 with no request inspection.

config.container: root user, read-write filesystem, no seccomp profile
config.load_balancer: ALB with default listener, no WAF attached
